sorry_declarations_note: All four code-level `sorry` are the intentional challenge-statement placeholders in ComparatorChallenges/*.lean (adapted from google-deepmind/formal-conjectures). No file outside ComparatorChallenges/ imports ComparatorChallenges (grep: 0 hits), and the two ComparatorChallenges modules import only `Mathlib`, so these sorries are unreachable from the main theorems. The solution modules (NavierStokes/ComparatorSolution.lean, Euler/Solution.lean) and their 580 / 1829-module project closures contain 0 `sorry` and 0 `admit`. The solution files re-state the theorems under the same names and prove them by `exact` from bridge lemmas; the Comparator tool (config ComparatorChallenges/*.json) is what would establish statement-identity between challenge and solution.

options_and_macros.detail: No `set_option` line anywhere in the 2486 project files: no maxHeartbeats, maxRecDepth, autoImplicit, linter.*, or debug.skipKernelTC overrides.

Euler lib: autoImplicit = false, warningAsError = true. NavierStokes lib and ComparatorChallenges lib: NO leanOptions, so they compile with Lean's default `autoImplicit := true` (verified in the pinned toolchain's Lean/Elab/AutoBound.lean, defValue := true). This is not a kernel-trust extension, but it means an unbound identifier in a NavierStokes statement silently becomes an implicit universally-quantified variable. The Comparator statement-identity check on the two NS main theorems (if run) protects those two statements; it does not protect intermediate NavierStokes lemmas from being weaker than intended, though they are still kernel-checked as stated.
No custom syntax, macros, or elaborators in the project; nothing can hide a `sorry` behind a macro.

Classical.propDecidable is a standard classical instance (uses Classical.choice, already permitted). In 62 files; ordinary typeclass instances scoped to a section. Not trust-extending.
The project asks Lean to print the axioms of all four main theorems at the end of the solution files. Their output is only produced by a build and was not observed here.
